title: fix(rest)!: an empty `?id=` on the app list is refused 400 naming the parameter instead of read as absent
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XG3uopXrSJccJc9XqnMV8ty)_

Fixes #28548

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — `GET /meta/app` and `GET /meta/apps` (on `RestServer` and on the runtime dispatcher, which hand their store answer to the same list chain) refuse an empty `?id=` with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the parameter; they answered 200 with the caller's whole visible app list before. Nothing is widened: no export, answer member, error code or status is added.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`GET /api/v1/meta/app?id=`（id 为空）现在回 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`，消息点名参数 `id`，不再返回调用者能看到的全部应用。
- **为什么改**：以前空 id 被当成“没写”，调用方本想取一个应用，名字却是空的，结果拿到整张应用列表，看起来像正常结果。和 #27484（空 `$searchFields` 被当成没写）同一类，按同样方式拒收。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响发了空 `id` 的 API 调用方；`@objectstack/client` 和 Console 读应用列表都不带 `id`。非空 id、不带 id、重复 id 的回答都不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`（`createMetaListAnswer` 第 3 步和 `refuseEmptyAppIdFilter`）、`packages/rest/src/meta-app-publish-gate.test.ts`（有意翻转的钉子）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-app-publish-gate.test.ts`，预期 26 个用例全过（空 id 三种调用者都回 400，空格 id 仍回空列表）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（进队前欠一次契约复核）。

## What changes

- **`createMetaListAnswer` step 3** (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`): the app filter used to skip an empty `id` (`typeof appIdFilter === 'string' && appIdFilter !== ''`), so the request was served as if no filter had been sent. An empty value now goes to the new `refuseEmptyAppIdFilter()`, which throws `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `param: 'id'` and the message `Query parameter 'id' names no app; got "". …`. The throw reaches each transport's own error door (`RestServer`'s `handleRouteError`, the dispatcher's `errorFromThrown`), the way `refuseUnknownMetaListType` already answers on this route, so neither transport hand-builds a body.
- **Order kept.** The refusal sits in step 3, after the per-caller visibility gate (step 2), which keeps its place. The chain stays the one place a list step lives, so both transports answer the same.
- **Unchanged.** A non-empty `id` narrows as before (one app, or an empty list when it names none, `' '` included). No `id` lists every app the caller may see. A repeated `id` is still the arity 400 at the door entry. `?id=` on any other type is still ignored.
- **Docblock** of `createMetaListAnswer` step 3 updated to say an empty value is refused.
- **Pin flipped on purpose**: `meta-app-publish-gate.test.ts` "an ABSENT id still returns the whole published set" asserted that `?id=` (empty) returns the full list, citing an unset `select` as its producer. No producer sends it (see Acceptance notes), and the card's expected result rules the other way, so that half moves to the new refusal case.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28548-empty-app-id-refused.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/rest`, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `@objectstack/runtime` changes only a test, which its `files[]` does not ship.

### Which precedent, and why

The card offers two outcomes: refuse with a 400 naming the parameter, or match nothing as `' '` does. This follows the precedent PR #27670 set for #27484: that change refused a blank `$searchFields` with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `param` set and a message naming the parameter, rather than reading it as a value that matches nothing. Along the four axes: there is no real caller that sends an empty `id` (measured below), so the loud answer costs nobody; a refusal is the contract-first answer and the one that stops an AI-written client from mistaking a blank name for a real filter; and it adds no gate or surface, only a refusal on the existing door.

## Tests

<details><summary>Red first, then green (head 9246901a)</summary>

- Red, on the base code with the new tests: `meta-app-publish-gate.test.ts` "an EMPTY id is refused…" failed (`expected 200 to be 400`, 1 failed / 25 passed); `meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` row A "the reference moves" failed on the new `?id=` assertion (1 failed / 906 passed). The row A matrix cells for `?id= (empty)` passed on the base, because both transports agreed on the wrong 200.
- Green after the fix and a `rest` rebuild: 26/26 and 907/907.
- New cases: an empty `id` as a builder (`studio.access`), as `manage_users` and as a caller holding nothing, on `/meta/app`, and on `/meta/apps`, each asserting `status` 400, `code` `VALIDATION_ERROR`, the message's first clause, and no items. The dispatcher's twin is pinned by the new `?id= (empty)` probe in `@objectstack/runtime`'s list parity census: every type × caller cell must answer the same `status` + `code` + items on both transports, and row A asserts `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with no items.
- Controls: `?id=crm` returns that one app, no `id` returns the visible list, `?id=` with a space still returns `200 []`, repeated `id` stays 400, `?id=` on `view` is still ignored. All pre-existing cases in the same file.

</details>

Anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob 24ba18a4 → acc770c9; rebuilt `@objectstack/rest`; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/rest ABLATE_28548` hit in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`. Restored: blob after == HEAD 24ba18a4, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuilt; preflight `--absent` clean over 6 built files, tree clean.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Producers checked for an empty `id`: `@objectstack/client`'s `meta.getItems(type, { packageId })` sends no `id`; no file under `ui/packages`, `ui/apps`, `packages/client/src` or `packages/cli/src` builds a `meta/app?id=` request. The QA ledger rows under `docs/qa/platform-checklist` that read `/meta/app?id=` all name an app; none asserts the empty answer.
- The refusal body on `RestServer` is the flat `{ error, code }` its route error door writes for a thrown refusal (the same door `refuseUnknownMetaListType` uses on this route); the repeated-`id` 400 at the door entry writes the nested `{ error: { code, message } }`. Both carry `VALIDATION_ERROR`. The dispatcher writes its own envelope with the same `error.code`. Not changed here.
- `?id=` with a space keeps its answer (`200 []`): the ruling keeps every non-empty `id` as it was. #27484 refused a whitespace-only `$searchFields`, but there the value is split into names and trimmed; an app name is compared whole.
- Same file, same class, not changed: `createMetaListAnswer` step 4 reads `?object=` on `view` with a truthiness test (`query?.object`), so `GET /meta/view?object=` lists every view, unsorted and including views bound to no object, as if no filter were sent. It is the same empty-as-absent class, but the guard is a different spelling, the card does not rule its outcome, and no producer sends an empty `object` (the console reads `meta.getItems('view')` with no query). Reported to the seat to file or fold.
- Branch `claude/project-thread-cq2t0t` is the card thread's harness-pinned branch, named in claim 6554674218; it carries no issue number. Signature: `domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pQoUJCqKk6SJQb6Qx`.
- No open PR touched `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` at the claim's read.
